ECDF Plot Comparing Model Strategies (fixed prior)

Source: R/ecdf_model_plot.R
ecdf_model_plot.Rd

ECDF (+ optional density) comparing sensitivity model strategies – All studies, Excluding High RoB, PET-PEESE, Mixture Model, BMA – for a single prior. Colour represents the model strategy/section.

Usage

ecdf_model_plot(
  model,
  data,
  priors,
  measure,
  prior_to_plot = NULL,
  study_var = NULL,
  rob_var = NULL,
  exclude_high_rob = FALSE,
  incl_common_effect = FALSE,
  incl_random_effect = TRUE,
  incl_pet_peese = FALSE,
  incl_selection_weight = FALSE,
  incl_robma = FALSE,
  robma_fit = NULL,
  pet_peese_direction = "negative",
  pet_peese_threshold = 0.1,
  prob_reference = "null",
  null_value = NULL,
  null_range = NULL,
  add_null_range = FALSE,
  color_null_range = "#77bb41",
  label_control = "Control",
  label_intervention = "Intervention",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  x_label = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  color_palette = NULL,
  show_density = TRUE,
  font = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A fitted brmsfit meta-analysis model.

data

Study-level data used to fit model.

priors

Named list of prior specs; each element a list with name, mu_prior, tau_prior.

measure

Effect measure ("OR","RR","HR","IRR","MD","SMD").

prior_to_plot

Name (in priors) of the prior to display. Defaults to the first prior.

study_var, rob_var

Optional unquoted column names (study id / RoB).

exclude_high_rob, incl_common_effect, incl_random_effect, incl_pet_peese, incl_selection_weight, incl_robma

Logical section toggles.

robma_fit

A fitted RoBMA object (required if incl_robma).

pet_peese_direction, pet_peese_threshold

PET-PEESE options.

prob_reference

"null" or "null_range".

null_value, null_range, add_null_range, color_null_range

Null / ROPE options.

label_control, label_intervention

Arm labels for the density panel.

title, subtitle, x_label, xlim, x_breaks, color_palette, show_density, font

Display options.

Value

A ggplot (or patchwork) object.
